Insurance / coverage.notes: C-CDA has no section for payer/insurance details beyond basic header

Encounters / visits.notes: C-CDA Encounters section exists but limited vs full visit model

Problems / diagnoses.notes: C-CDA Problems section; USCDI v1 includes conditions

Medications / prescriptions.notes: C-CDA Medications section; USCDI v1 includes meds

Allergies.notes: C-CDA Allergies section; USCDI v1 includes allergies

Immunizations.notes: C-CDA Immunizations section; USCDI v1 includes immunizations

Vitals.notes: C-CDA Vital Signs section; USCDI v1 includes vitals

Lab results.notes: C-CDA Results section; USCDI v1 includes lab results

Procedures.notes: C-CDA Procedures section; USCDI v1 includes procedures

Clinical notes.notes: USCDI v1 includes clinical notes but may not capture full podiatry-specific structured data

Care plans / goals.notes: C-CDA has Goals and Plan of Treatment sections

Orders / referrals.notes: C-CDA can represent some orders but not full order lifecycle

Billing (CPT/ICD codes, claims, invoices.notes: C-CDA has no billing/claims sections; DOX auto-extracts CPT/ICD from charts

Payments.notes: C-CDA has no payment tracking capability

Podiatry-specific structured data.notes: Pre-built podiatry database for conditions below the knee; proprietary structured data unlikely to map to standard C-CDA

Patient portal data (patient-entered his.notes: Patient-completed online histories not representable in C-CDA

Clinical quality measures (MIPS).notes: CQM numerator/denominator data not in C-CDA
